name: Aerlen
lore: Aerlen prefer anonymity and try to avoid conflict. Aerlen ships are very agile and difficult to target.

activeAbility.name: Cryobloom Protocol
activeAbility.desc: Starts a Cryobloom event on an icy planet, boosting all production by 11% for 5 days. Costs 900 energy*

name: Human
lore: Humans adapt quickly to their surroundings, and fit a wide variety of roles.

name: Inergon
lore: Inergon are beings capable of absorbing energy from everything around them.

name: Konqul
lore: The Konqul are a race of rigidly organized and aggressive soldiers.

name: Sillixx
lore: Sillixx are well known as proficient traders. Their ships are larger than all other races.

activeAbility.name: Dunescour Burrowing
activeAbility.desc: Unlocks an active ability that allows the Sillixx to temporarily boost planet production on Desert worlds*

name: Vygoid
lore: The Vygoid replaced most of their original physiology with technology. They have an affinity for all scientific pursuits.

name: Drannik
lore: The Drannik are clever machinists that know how to exploit the weaknesses of their enemies.
bonus: 40% extra ship attack against non-player enemies

activeAbility.name: Hornulox Symbiont
activeAbility.desc: Places a random Hornulox Symbiont on a planet. Symbionts are vastly inferior if placed on planets larger than Average. Costs 2 Aeon Badges.

name: Zolazin
lore: The Zolazin are advanced cyborgs that use their superior stealth to pursue their agenda.

name: Lazuli
lore: The Lazuli are master ship builders, taking their skills from their former Syndicate rulers.

activeAbility.name: Thavix Reactor
activeAbility.desc: Builds a Thavix Reactor on planets with 3 other distinct structures that provide % bonuses to any production. Requires 800 Neutronium. Limit 1 per planet

name: Genetarr
lore: The Genetarr have strong psionic abilities.

name: Taltherian
lore: The Taltherians have a complex history building amazing cities.

name: Mylarai
lore: The Mylarai are the wealthiest and most reckless miners in the galaxy.

name: Kronyn
lore: The Kronyn are a technocracy of brilliant scientists and engineers.

name: Xecti
bonus: 40% bonus to ship attack and defense while being attacked, and 40% bonus to all attack and defense on your planet colonies.
lore: The Xecti easily react and adapt to all forms of incoming aggression.

name: Litheor
bonus: Deep-Phase Probe (builds a special structure on one of your planets)
lore: The Litheor are a long-living race that survive underground.

name: Uldrinan

ability.name: Uldrinan Quota
ability.desc: Issues you a Salary of 2 Uldri Trade Credits.

bonus: Uldrinan Quota (provides special currency for items)
lore: The Uldrinan hold unique territory ideal for trade and technology.

name: Bahreen
lore: The Bahreen have a special connection to Prismodne energy.
